title: I found a cool trading app
author: mehoffnm
selftext:
I thought I would share this new trading UI I found.  It's actually quite addictive.  I was able to make pretty decent returns and I am now testing the AI feature, it's working well so far.  It appears to be trading newly created meme coins.  

I was able to trade with a test account and then I created a wallet and funded it.  I like this app and I recommend it.

https://popnpump.com/
